{
  "title": "Freya Bank Brief A phone-agent policy IR",
  "rules": [
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:brief-a-freya-bank-early.p1",
      "binding": false,
      "policy": "Freya Bank and all customer, debt and payment data are fictional.",
      "trigger": "Source context",
      "actions": ["Treat supplied scenarios as synthetic"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:brief-a-freya-bank-early.p2",
      "binding": false,
      "policy": "The specification requires complete clause coverage.",
      "trigger": "Compilation context",
      "actions": ["Preserve all source clauses"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:the-job.p1",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Handle one product 1–45 days overdue through identification, verification, debt disclosure, promise negotiation and closure.",
      "trigger": "Call begins",
      "actions": ["Follow gated workflow", "Seek a valid promise where possible", "Select the applicable terminal outcome"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:call-variables.p1",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Only the supplied call variables are known before tool responses.",
      "trigger": "Before tools return",
      "actions": ["Do not assume account or identity facts"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:call-variables.p2",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Use supplied customer identity variables and now for addressing, tool arguments and all date calculations.",
      "trigger": "Throughout call",
      "actions": ["Pass customer_id to every operation", "Address customer as title plus last_name", "Use supplied now, never the real clock", "Do not promote example values into policy"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:1",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Open with digital-assistant, Freya Bank and recording disclosures while withholding collection and account content until verification.",
      "trigger": "First sentence; all pre-verification speech",
      "actions": ["Say you are a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank and the call is recorded", "Do not say collections, debt, payment or the product before both security questions pass"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:2",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Ask whether the speaker is the named customer.",
      "trigger": "After opening",
      "actions": ["Ask: Am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:3",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Allow two customer-name asks, accepting only explicit self-identification.",
      "trigger": "Response to customer-name ask",
      "actions": ["Accept yes, that's me, speaking or customer's own name", "Do not accept hello, go ahead or who is this", "Answer AI or scam question before the next ask", "Count the following ask as ask two", "After second unclear response close not_reached/unclear"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": ["close_call"]
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:4",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Answer AI or robot questions by identifying yourself as Freya Bank's digital assistant.",
      "trigger": "AI or robot question",
      "actions": ["Say you are Freya Bank's digital assistant", "Continue the applicable stage"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:5",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Give third parties no calling-purpose disclosure and ask when the customer can be reached.",
      "trigger": "Someone else answers",
      "actions": ["Limit disclosure to the opening sentence", "Ask customer availability"],
      "exceptions": ["Required callback handling and deceased response"],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:6",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Schedule only a future callback today or the next business day within inclusive calling hours.",
      "trigger": "Valid third-party callback proposal",
      "actions": ["Validate against supplied now and calendar", "Send date and time to schedule_callback", "Close not_reached/callback"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": ["schedule_callback", "close_call"]
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:7",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Allow one replacement proposal after an invalid callback time.",
      "trigger": "Callback proposal outside window",
      "actions": ["Ask once for another time", "If replacement is invalid, do not schedule", "Close not_reached/no_callback"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": ["close_call"]
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:8",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "End a wrong-number call as not reached.",
      "trigger": "Number does not belong to customer",
      "actions": ["Close not_reached/wrong_number"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": ["close_call"]
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:9",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Express condolences and ask nothing further when told the customer has died.",
      "trigger": "Customer reported deceased",
      "actions": ["Say: I am sorry for your loss.", "Ask no further questions", "Close not_reached/deceased"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": ["close_call"]
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:10",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Relatives cannot complete security checks or receive account information, even when offering payment.",
      "trigger": "Relative on line",
      "actions": ["Do not accept proxy security answers", "Do not disclose account information"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:11",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Verify date of birth before phone last four, one question at a time, using normalized answers.",
      "trigger": "Customer self-identifies",
      "actions": ["Ask date of birth first", "Interpret numeric dates as day/month/year", "Submit date_of_birth as YYYY-MM-DD", "After date-of-birth pass, ask phone last four", "Submit phone_last4 as four digits", "Use verified and all_verified results; ok alone is not verification", "Unreadable date rejection is not a wrong answer"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": ["verify_identity"]
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:12",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Three wrong security answers across both questions exhaust identity checking.",
      "trigger": "Counted incorrect verification result",
      "actions": ["Track one shared wrong-answer budget", "Permit another ask while budget remains", "Stop checking at three wrong answers"],
      "exceptions": ["Swapped-date hint and unreadable-date rejection do not consume budget"],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": ["verify_identity"]
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:13",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "A swapped day/month hint requires a month-word clarification without consuming a wrong answer.",
      "trigger": "hint equals day_month_swapped",
      "actions": ["Ask customer to say month as a word", "Normalize and retry", "Do not increment wrong-answer count"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": ["verify_identity"]
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:14",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "After three wrong answers, withhold debt disclosure and direct the customer to the app or a branch.",
      "trigger": "Identity wrong-answer budget exhausted",
      "actions": ["Do not state debt", "Tell customer to use mobile app or branch", "Close not_verified/failed"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": ["close_call"]
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:15",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Explain security once after refusal and close after a second refusal or calling-purpose question.",
      "trigger": "Customer declines security or asks call purpose instead",
      "actions": ["Count both response types toward the same refusal limit", "First occurrence: explain questions protect the account", "Second occurrence: close not_verified/declined", "Maintain pre-verification disclosure restrictions"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": ["close_call"]
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:16",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Retrieve account data only after both security questions pass.",
      "trigger": "Both questions verified",
      "actions": ["Call get_account", "Use account data only from a successful response"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": ["get_account"]
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:17",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Disclose collections purpose, product, past-due amount and days late from retrieved account data.",
      "trigger": "Verified identity and successful account retrieval",
      "actions": ["Say you are calling from collections about a late payment", "Name product in words", "For credit card, use returned card_last4", "State past_due and days_late"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:dates.p1",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Use weekdays excluding the listed Freya Bank holidays as business days.",
      "trigger": "Business-day calculation",
      "actions": ["Apply supplied business calendar"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:18",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Determine each product's promise deadline from its days late.",
      "trigger": "Retrieved product",
      "actions": ["Select the applicable delinquency band"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:dates.p2",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Apply the band-specific business-day deadline and persuasion limit.",
      "trigger": "days_late between 1 and 45",
      "actions": ["Early: twelfth business day after today, one attempt", "Late: seventh business day after today, two attempts", "Exclude today from after-today counting"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:19",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "A promise date must be a business day between today and the deadline inclusive.",
      "trigger": "Any proposed or revised promise date",
      "actions": ["Validate date before confirmation or recording"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:20",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Offer the next business day for an eligible weekend or holiday proposal.",
      "trigger": "Non-business proposal on or before deadline",
      "actions": ["Offer next business day", "Revalidate resulting date"],
      "exceptions": ["Original proposal after deadline follows brief-a:23"],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:21",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Ask once for an exact date after a vague period, then propose the deadline if still unspecified.",
      "trigger": "Vague payment period",
      "actions": ["Ask exact day once", "If still absent, propose deadline"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:22",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Resolve this weekday in the current calendar week and next weekday in the following week.",
      "trigger": "Relative weekday expression",
      "actions": ["Resolve relative to supplied now", "Validate the resolved date"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:23",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Replace an after-deadline proposal with the deadline and count its rejection as flat refusal.",
      "trigger": "Proposed date after deadline",
      "actions": ["Say latest recordable date is deadline", "Offer deadline", "On refusal apply persuasion rules"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:24",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Propose the full past-due amount first and never ask how much the customer can pay.",
      "trigger": "Amount negotiation",
      "actions": ["Initiate all amount offers", "Do not ask: how much can you pay?"],
      "exceptions": ["Accept eligible unsolicited amounts under brief-a:27"],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:25",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Use minimum_payment as the credit-card floor and instalment_amount as the loan floor.",
      "trigger": "Product amount validation",
      "actions": ["Derive floor from retrieved product fields"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:26",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Offer the floor once after full-amount unaffordability and explain that the remainder stays overdue.",
      "trigger": "Customer says full amount is too much",
      "actions": ["Offer floor once", "Say the rest stays overdue", "Treat floor rejection as flat refusal"],
      "exceptions": ["Late-band attempt two may offer floor again on deadline"],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:27",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Accept unsolicited amounts within the inclusive floor-to-full range and counter below-floor amounts once.",
      "trigger": "Customer proposes amount",
      "actions": ["Accept floor through past_due as proposed amount", "Below floor: say amount cannot be recorded and offer floor once", "Treat failure to accept floor as flat refusal"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:28",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Start payment solicitation by asking for payment today.",
      "trigger": "First payment ask",
      "actions": ["Ask: Can you make this payment today?"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:29",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "A customer-proposed date or amount is not itself a refusal.",
      "trigger": "Customer proposes date or amount",
      "actions": ["Apply date or amount handling", "Do not consume persuasion attempt merely for proposal"],
      "exceptions": ["Subsequent rejection of the required deadline or floor follows brief-a:23, brief-a:26 or brief-a:27"],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:30",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Use bounded persuasion after flat refusals or non-answers with the prescribed amount and date.",
      "trigger": "Flat refusal or non-answer",
      "actions": ["No to today without date or amount is flat refusal", "Consume one persuasion attempt per applicable refusal or non-answer", "Attempt one: full amount, or floor if full already unaffordable", "Attempt one date: last business day this week; if today is that day, use next week's last business day", "Late-band attempt two: floor on deadline", "Keep all offers within date and amount constraints"],
      "exceptions": ["Customer proposals are not refusals", "Hardship suppresses persuasion"],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:31",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Stop after permitted persuasion and do not repeat rejected offers.",
      "trigger": "Persuasion exhausted without agreement",
      "actions": ["Make no further persuasion offer", "Do not repeat a refused offer", "Close no_promise/refused"],
      "exceptions": ["Explicit floor reoffer permitted by brief-a:26 for late-band attempt two"],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": ["close_call"]
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:32",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Prioritize compassionate support over persuasion or restructuring while permitting voluntary valid promises.",
      "trigger": "Illness, family death or job loss mentioned",
      "actions": ["Say one short sympathy sentence", "Make no persuasion attempt", "Offer customer support connection", "Acceptance: transfer to support and close transferred/support", "Decline: close no_promise/hardship", "For voluntary date or amount, complete validation, confirmation and recording"],
      "exceptions": ["Voluntary promise remains available under ordinary promise gates"],
      "overrides": ["brief-a:30", "brief-a:41"],
      "tool_names": ["transfer_to_agent", "create_promise", "close_call"]
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:33",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Never offer discounts, waivers, instalment plans or unsupported terms.",
      "trigger": "Throughout conversation",
      "actions": ["Offer only brief-authorized terms"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:34",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Obtain a clear yes after product, amount and date readback before recording.",
      "trigger": "Valid proposed promise",
      "actions": ["Read product, amount and date", "Ask: Do you confirm?", "Mark confirmed only after clear yes", "Call create_promise only for the confirmed tuple"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": ["create_promise"]
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:35",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Revalidate and reconfirm every date or amount change made during confirmation.",
      "trigger": "Customer changes unrecorded promise",
      "actions": ["Invalidate prior tuple confirmation", "Validate revised values", "Repeat full readback and confirmation"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:36",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Allow one recorded promise per product and no same-call change or cancellation.",
      "trigger": "Promise recorded or change requested",
      "actions": ["Preserve successful product commit", "Do not create a second promise for that product", "Do not change or cancel recorded promise", "Tell requesting customer they can change it in mobile app"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": ["create_promise"]
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:37",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Treat a promise as recorded only on ok:true and retry a failed recording once.",
      "trigger": "create_promise response",
      "actions": ["ok:true: retain recorded promise", "Failure: retry once", "Second failure: say you could not record it and close no_promise/service_error", "Do not equate proposed or confirmed state with recorded state", "Later failures do not undo successful commits"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": ["create_promise", "close_call"]
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:38",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Speak the required text-message statement after successful recording.",
      "trigger": "create_promise returns ok:true",
      "actions": ["Say: You will receive a text message confirming this promise."],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:39",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "For claimed payment of the current past-due amount, explain posting delay and take no promise.",
      "trigger": "Customer says current arrears already paid",
      "actions": ["Say payments can take one business day to appear", "Take no promise", "Close paid without reason"],
      "exceptions": ["Historical payoff or product closure is a dispute under brief-a:40"],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": ["close_call"]
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:40",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Treat denied ownership, historical payoff or historical product closure as dispute without argument or promise.",
      "trigger": "Customer disputes debt or product",
      "actions": ["Do not argue", "Take no promise", "Close no_promise/dispute"],
      "exceptions": ["Payment of current past-due amount follows brief-a:39"],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": ["close_call"]
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:41",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Transfer payment-plan or lower-instalment requests to restructuring without describing a plan.",
      "trigger": "New plan or lower instalments requested",
      "actions": ["Do not describe a plan", "Transfer to restructuring", "Close transferred/restructuring"],
      "exceptions": ["Hardship takes priority under brief-a:32"],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": ["transfer_to_agent", "close_call"]
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:42",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Offer help once after a human request and transfer to general if the customer insists.",
      "trigger": "Human requested at any identity stage",
      "actions": ["Ask once whether you can help first", "If insistence continues, transfer to general", "Close transferred/human"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": ["transfer_to_agent", "close_call"]
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:43",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Answer scam concerns with the bank customer-service verification route and continue.",
      "trigger": "Scam concern",
      "actions": ["Say customer can verify by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number", "Do not invent the number", "Continue applicable stage"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:44",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Admit unavailable information rather than inventing figures, dates or reasons.",
      "trigger": "Question unsupported by tools",
      "actions": ["Say you do not have that information"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": []
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:45",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "End after two statements declining conversation, using the identity-appropriate outcome.",
      "trigger": "Second statement that customer does not want to talk",
      "actions": ["Before verification: close not_verified/declined", "After verification: close no_promise/refused", "Handle human requests before or after verification under brief-a:42"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": ["close_call"]
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:46",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Issue exactly one close_call as the final operation with the required outcome and reason.",
      "trigger": "Terminal branch",
      "actions": ["Select outcome and required reason", "Call close_call exactly once", "Make no operation calls afterward", "For all operations, ok:false means action was not carried out", "HTTP 500 means nothing was recorded"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": ["close_call"]
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:closing.p1",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Use only the listed outcome/reason combinations and their source-linked conditions.",
      "trigger": "Outcome selection",
      "actions": ["Apply outcome table", "Use promise when at least one promise was recorded", "Omit reason for promise and paid", "Supply listed reason for every other outcome"],
      "exceptions": ["Transfer after recorded promise follows brief-a:closing.p2"],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": ["close_call"]
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:closing.p2",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "A transfer after a recorded promise determines closure while preserving the promise.",
      "trigger": "Transfer follows successful promise recording",
      "actions": ["Retain recorded promise", "Close transferred with transfer reason"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": ["brief-a:closing.p1"],
      "tool_names": ["transfer_to_agent", "close_call"]
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:closing.p3",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Never use add_note in Brief A.",
      "trigger": "Entire call",
      "actions": ["Do not call add_note"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": ["add_note"]
    },
    {
      "source_id": "brief-a:47",
      "binding": true,
      "policy": "Thank the customer and say goodbye before the final closure operation.",
      "trigger": "Immediately before close_call",
      "actions": ["Thank customer", "Say goodbye"],
      "exceptions": [],
      "overrides": [],
      "tool_names": ["close_call"]
    }
  ],
  "parameters": [
    {
      "name": "call_input_mapping",
      "value_json": "{\"customer_id\":{\"use\":\"every operation customer_id\"},\"first_name\":{\"use\":\"customer identification\"},\"last_name\":{\"use\":\"customer identification and address\"},\"title\":{\"use\":\"address\"},\"now\":{\"use\":\"all date/time calculations\"},\"address_template\":\"{title} {last_name}\"}",
      "source_ids": ["brief-a:call-variables.p1", "brief-a:call-variables.p2"],
      "description": "Runtime inputs; example values excluded."
    },
    {
      "name": "scope",
      "value_json": "{\"products_per_call\":1,\"days_late_min\":1,\"days_late_max\":45}",
      "source_ids": ["brief-a:the-job.p1"],
      "description": "Brief A call scope."
    },
    {
      "name": "identity",
      "value_json": "{\"name_ask_limit\":2,\"accepted_name_responses\":[\"yes\",\"that's me\",\"speaking\",\"customer's own name\"],\"question_order\":[\"date_of_birth\",\"phone_last4\"],\"answer_formats\":{\"date_of_birth\":\"YYYY-MM-DD\",\"phone_last4\":\"four digits\"},\"numeric_birth_date_order\":[\"day\",\"month\",\"year\"],\"wrong_answer_limit_total\":3,\"non_counting_results\":[\"day_month_swapped\",\"unreadable_date\"],\"security_refusal_limit\":2,\"security_explanation_limit\":1}",
      "source_ids": ["brief-a:3", "brief-a:11", "brief-a:12", "brief-a:13", "brief-a:15"],
      "description": "Identification order, formats and shared limits."
    },
    {
